coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Walk (330 Berry St)
record.summary: Mission Walk is a below-market-rate condominium development at 330 and 335 Berry St, built under the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency's Affordable Homeownership Program; this building (330 Berry St) was completed in 2009 per DataSF Assessor records, with its BMR units among the 131 across both addresses allocated by a lottery in January 2009.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8704278), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 56656119) for the name and street address, but trimmed against the adjacent, already-committed Arterra footprint to remove a 712 sq m overlap (see digitization_method). The trimmed shape may understate this building's true footprint along the shared edge with Arterra; not a hand trace or plan estimate otherwise. Updated 2026-09-20: extended north by a real-gap-fragment piece sized to this building's own footprint width, per the owner's direct cut -- not independently sourced or verified against a building footprint of its own.
